title: Entitled Dad Think’s He’s Untouchable, Doesn’t End Well
description:
On June 16th, 2024. A man was arrested after calling law enforcement 14 times to harass operators and ask deputies to bring his daughter to him. This is body-cam footage of the events.

Disclaimer:
